reviewItem.question: Does "cca748591737d568e5b976cb060b960c40bd8c14: feat!: update compareoptions default values" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=compareoptions (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The v3.0.0 release notes state that a breaking-change-marked feature (commit cca748591737d568e5b976cb060b960c40bd8c14, #22230) updates the default values of the compareoptions settings, without specifying which options changed or the old and new values.
